prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide landing-page hero for a kid-safe educational browser simulator. Scene: optimistic 1930s art-deco transit poster with simplified geometric reservoirs, filter tanks, pipes, pylons, a compact turbine hall, bakery ovens, conveyor and small houses. Style: crisp flat screen-printed illustration on warm paper with subtle ink grain and bold architectural silhouettes. Palette: midnight navy, cream paper, marigold, muted teal-blue, restrained coral accents. Constraints: clear silhouettes, appropriate for children, decorative rather than a technical diagram. Avoid: text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, logo, branded objects, real people, copyrighted characters, photorealism, fantasy machinery, illegible symbols.
